summary: Fresh build tested end-to-end. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass across auth, suppliers, products (incl. last-cost), receipts (create/list/approve/staff-scope/double-approve), POS inventory sync, and staff management (403/409/toggle). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login as admin OK, receive screen supplier picker + manual barcode add works, repeated identical barcode increments existing cart row qty (verified visually — Indomie qty=3 after add+dup-add+plus), unknown barcode opens 'Produk Baru' modal and adds new row on confirm, submit-receipt succeeds, audit tab lists pending receipt with cost editor + last-price and approve button, approve triggers 'Disetujui & disinkron ke POS' toast, account screen renders staff CRUD (add/toggle) and logout. No red-screen errors, no failing API calls, no CORS issues on the configured preview URL. Two minor test-harness quirks (not app bugs) noted below.

issues: Minor: console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted by a child View (React Native Web 0.19+). Non-blocking but should be migrated to style.pointerEvents to silence in future RN Web versions.

action_items: Optional: replace `pointerEvents` prop usage with `style={{ pointerEvents: '...' }}` to silence RN-Web deprecation warning.
Optional cleanup: seed data currently accumulates TEST_ staff/suppliers from repeated test runs (visible in Akun list). Not a bug, but consider a periodic prune or explicit teardown fixture.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly uses async motor everywhere, excludes Mongo _id, validates with Pydantic, uses env vars for all secrets, and enforces admin-only via dependency. Good separation.
Bcrypt password truncation at 72 chars (hash_password/verify_password) is applied consistently and matches passlib bcrypt limit — good defensive handling.
Suppliers POST is idempotent by name (returns existing on duplicate) — matches spec.

receipts.approve is not idempotent-safe against races: two admins approving simultaneously could both pass the `status != approved` check and double-increment stock. Consider a conditional update `{status: 'pending_audit'}` guard on the initial update or a transaction. Low priority (single-admin flow expected).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_ prefixed suppliers and staff and one unknown barcode product (auto-created via receipt flow). Cleanup is not aggressive; suppliers and staff persist under TEST_ prefix for easy identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + frontend both pass fully. Preview URL https://pos-inventory-hub-68.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin creds admin@gudang.com/admin123 (seeded). Note: camera barcode scanning uses expo-camera and cannot be exercised via headless Playwright; only manual-barcode path and permission screen render can be verified. Playwright `text_content` on a TextInput qty stepper returns empty string — read via input value/screenshot instead.
